metadata.documentation: The objective of this field campaign was to study the Lake Michigan springtime lake-breeze circulation in Milwaukee. Measurements of profiles of temperature, humidity, winds, clouds and aerosols were made by the SPARC facility from the University of Wisconsin-Madison. These activities were part of an atmospheric science measurements course taught by Prof. Clark Evans at the University of Wisconsin-Milwaukee.
